release_notes:
Make signup OTP editable + remove obsolete SMS Integration menu

- Signup OTP is now the editable 'SMS Verification At Signup' template (Templates > SMS Templates); register.php substitutes #COMPANY_NAME# / #OTP_CODE# with a fallback.
- Removes the obsolete SMS Integration menu + pages (legacy bulk SendSMS toggles), superseded by per-workflow toggles + client opt-out. Migration removes menu rows, orphan role permissions, and seeds the OTP template.
